item.description:
First release.
### Added
- **Your WhatsApp history, kept on your own Mac.** WA Archive pairs with an iPhone over USB, pulls a WhatsApp backup, and turns it into a searchable archive on an encrypted volume you control. Nothing leaves the machine, and the app makes no network request outside checking for its own updates. - **Search that works on real messages.** Full-text search covers Latin and non-Latin scripts, emoji, and mixed queries, with sort, keyset paging, and jumps to any date in the middle of a conversation. - **Media alongside the transcript.** Photos, video thumbnails, voice notes converted for playback, and waveform display, with every attachment inline where it was sent. - **Storage you can measure and reclaim.** Retention tooling breaks usage into five categories and deletes what you choose in one confirmation, leaving source backups alone. - **The archive is readable by your own tools.** A local API and an MCP server serve chats, transcripts, search, stats, and media over stdio, and `export` writes the whole archive to NDJSON with a manifest. - **The app updates itself.** Sparkle checks a signed feed, verifies each update with an Ed25519 signature before installing, and shows these notes.
### Security
- Every release is signed with a Developer ID certificate, notarized by Apple, and stapled, so macOS opens it without a warning. Each download publishes a SHA-256 checksum and a provenance record naming the exact commit it was built from.
